title: Business Central Version 29: Recently Searched in Tell Me and Recently Used Lookups
summary: Business Central Version 29 introduces Recently Searched in Tell Me and Recently Used Lookups to help users navigate faster and enter data more efficiently. These personalized features reduce repetitive searching and clicks by surfacing frequently accessed pages and records based on user behavior patterns.
key_points: Recently Searched in Tell Me displays previous search history for quick access to pages, reports, and settings via Alt+Q
Recently Used Lookups automatically surface frequently accessed customer, vendor, item, and other records when opening lookup dialogs
Both features use server-side usage signals and platform intelligence to provide personalized recommendations tailored to each user's work patterns
Full search and browse capabilities remain available alongside intelligent suggestions, maintaining user flexibility

quotes.text: Full search and browse capabilities remain available. This ensures users maintain complete flexibility while benefiting from intelligent recommendations.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes that suggestions enhance rather than restrict the user experience, maintaining access to all records
